name: archebase-vi-guide
description: Use for any ArcheBase-branded design or review. This is a 3-layer VI system: SKILL.md orchestrates progressive disclosure; references contain route/page/domain rules; templates, manifests, tokens, checklists and validators make execution repeatable. Use with shared pptx for PowerPoint work.
